risk_controls.feature_availability_pit: features_safe_bfq_35.parquet has known_at and no available_at; this candidate explicitly uses feature_availability.mode=required_timestamp and column=known_at. Stage3 must verify known_at is present and aligned no later than signal date.
risk_controls.feature_instability: feature_importance must be inspected to ensure top features are not dominated by one unstable turnover, ATR, or oscillator column across retrain folds.
risk_controls.label_leakage: target remains supported forward_return with horizon=5 and price_column=close_qfq; Stage3 must audit close_qfq adjustment and target alignment through integrity_report.
risk_controls.overfit_complexity: v1 keeps low-complexity linear candidates only: ridge, lasso, elastic_net. No tree family is used in the first draft, and no explicit interaction builder is added.
risk_controls.split_regime_fragility: rolling 120 trading-date training window is preserved from the base config; Stage3 should inspect training_log and model_selection fold scores for no_finite_scores, low fold count, or regime-concentrated selection.
risk_controls.turnover_cost: model_selection uses rank_ic_minus_turnover_penalty as the intended selection metric, with transaction_cost.one_way_rate=0.001. Stage3 must verify parser support and compare selected candidate turnover proxy with realized screening turnover artifacts.
